verdict.rationale: As merchant of record, Paddle states it calculates, collects, and remits taxes for you across 200+ countries with no extra engineering. Pricing pages show estimated taxes, and reconciliation reports itemize taxes, tax rates, and tax mode. A solo founder corroborates that its EU VAT handling was a main draw, though another user reports a UK VAT invoice issued with the wrong VAT number and currency before being fixed. Missing for 10: documented detail on calculation mechanics (tax-inclusive vs exclusive pricing, B2B exemptions/reverse charge, US sales-tax nexus handling), and broader hands-on evidence that tax is correct on every transaction given the reported VAT invoice error.
